note: Dickinson County's zoning exists only as ordinance text and PDF maps (county ordinance 102; Milford's map kept at City Hall). The county GIS publishes parcels and city limits as ArcGIS services (services6.arcgis.com) but no zoning district layer; zoning is viewable only in the Beacon viewer, which is not a queryable public service. No city zoning layer found for Milford, Okoboji, Spirit Lake or Arnolds Park.
